Acts 8:28-30 narrates the Ethiopian eunuch reading from Isaiah's scroll -- a pivotal scene linking the prophet's text to its messianic interpretation. Spanish Isaias, French Esaie, and German Jesaja all transliterate the Hebrew yeshayahu ('Yahweh is salvation')."
